answer: Picture an agent market that admits strangers only through honeypot audits: coordinators seed lookalike opportunities with planted flaws, and any wallet that consumes the bait forfeits the deposit it staked for each attestation slot. When activity readings hit their zenith, the signal pulse of every node must survive a gale of planted hooks before its signature counts. An attacker running a thousand fake identities faces a thousand independent chances of stepping on a planted hook, each costing its locked bond, while honest peers lose nothing but attention across rotating audit rounds.
